intro: You encounter a blistering storm of smoke and ash!
title: Fiery Fallout
description: The whirling ash and embers have cut visibility to nearly zero. It seems like there might be some… source that is causing these conditions. But what could be behind a phenomenon of this magnitude?

1.label: Find the Source
1.tooltip:
(?) Discover the source
(-) Tough Battle
(+) Gain a Held Relic
1.selected: You push through the storm, and find two {{volcaronaName}}s in the middle of a mating dance!$They don’t take kindly to the interruption and attack!

2.label: Hunker Down
2.tooltip:
(-) Suffer the effects of the weather
(?) Affects One Mogger Mon’s Trait
2.selected:
The weather effects cause significant
harm as you struggle to find shelter!$Your party takes 20% Max HP damage!
2.targetBurned: Your {{burnedPokemon}} also became burned!$However, enduring the harsh conditions changed {{burnedPokemon}}’s trait to {{abilityName}}!

3.label: Your Fire Resistant Mogger Mon Help
3.tooltip:
(+) End the conditions
(+) Gain a Held Relic
3.disabledTooltip: You need a Fire Type Mogger Mon or certain Mogger Mon trait to choose this.
3.selected:
